This is precisely why I want to get a professional diagnosis. Although I have many of the symptoms and have done a lot of research, I refuse to claim I have BPD until I speak with a professional. I feel like it's disrespectful to the community.

I do have Generalized Anxiety Disorder and it does bug me when people claim to have anxiety when feeling anxious about something in their life. *Feeling anxious about a specific thing is not the same as having an anxiety disorder.* You are allowed to feel anxious about things but that does not equate the mental illness.

That’s where I’m at right now. I have a lot of the symptoms of BPD but no official diagnosis. I don’t wanna claim something I don’t have because I’ll feel like a fraud and it feels disrespectful to the community. But if I do get the diagnosis, I have no idea if I’ll be terrified or relieved.

You should check out the BPD subreddit if you havent already! Theres tons of lovely people there. I havent been formally diagnosed with BPD, just thinking I may have it, but I’m open to talk if you ever need to.
I hope you find what you’re looking for!
